gdd_sync.old: each file of `src/sim/graph/` opens with `@warning_ignore_start("integer_division")`, because every flux division is intentional integer division and would otherwise flood the editor with warnings; S0-b verifies that this annotation exists in 4.7.2 and silences the warning
gdd_sync.new: no file in `src/sim/graph/` carries an `integer_division` ignore: every division goes through `IntMath.floor_div`/`ceil_div`/`trunc_div` (ADR-0005 section 1.4; ADR-0010 SIM-04/SIM-05 allow exactly one ignore, in `IntMath.trunc_div`); S0-b no longer verifies the annotation (ADR-0011 section 2.3)

gdd_sync.old: every field is underscore-prefixed and a lint forbids writes outside the four writer files `graph_mutators.gd`, `graph_propagate.gd`, `graph_restore.gd` (decode, validate, swap) and `graph_derived.gd` (non-persisted caches only)
gdd_sync.new: every persisted column of `GraphState` is underscore-prefixed and written only in `graph_mutators.gd`, `graph_propagate.gd` and `graph_restore.gd`; derived caches, scratch buffers and diagnostics are the separate classes `GraphCaches` (written only by `graph_derived.gd`), `GraphScratch` and `GraphDiag`, and the DERIVED allowlist of the reflection test is the member list of those classes (ADR-0011 sections 1, 6.3, 12.1)

gdd_sync.old: Every check is raised through `GraphFault.raise(code, subject)`, which records the code, returns the failure to the kernel and, in debug, also halts
gdd_sync.new: Every check is raised through `GraphFault.raise_in(scope, code, subject)` (or `raise_ctx(ctx, code, subject, detail)` in restore and post_restore), which faults the scope or context with a domain-3 code and returns -code; the debug halt is the kernel's FAULTED dev rule (ADR-0011 section 8.2)

gdd_sync.old: a numeric *soft* violation in play is a *hard* failure on load, because a corrupt save must not be "fixed" into a different world
gdd_sync.new: a numeric soft violation in play is a hard failure on load against the physical ceilings in `GraphTuning`; a store above a lowered live catalog `stock_cap` is not a violation: it restores exactly and the first phase 0 clamps it, credits `discarded_*`, counts `stock_clamped` (not a saturation) and emits a diagnostic (ADR-0011 section 7.3; TR-itemdb-033)

gdd_sync.old: Instruments' `load = ⌊1000 × demand / max(1, supply)⌋` is its own reading, not `ρ`, and reads no `cap`
gdd_sync.new: the Graph publishes `true_value(LOAD_PM)` = 0 when `supply` is 0, else `min(1250, floor(1000 × demand / supply))`, with dead/idle/overload cases from `power_component_case`; Instruments reads it and derives nothing (ADR-0011 section 9.2; TR-instr-027)

gdd_sync.old: `alarm_sections()` → ascending, duplicate-free `section_id`s
gdd_sync.new: `alarm_sections(out: PackedInt32Array) -> int` fills a caller-owned buffer with ascending, duplicate-free `section_id`s and returns the count; the other list queries (`nodes_in`, `neighbors`, `open_ends`, `hull_segments_of`) use caller-owned buffers the same way; `step_no()` is `floor_div(T, GRAPH_STEP_TICKS)` (ADR-0011 section 9.1)

gdd_sync.old: (the packing and its range check are fixed by ADR-0011)
gdd_sync.new: composite packing is `(loop << 24) | anchor` with the anchor below `ID_MAX` 2^24; `F/<id>` is the DESC kind keyed per subject as `(subject_kind << 28) | subject_id`; `N/<id>` is the family of both the NODE and EDGE kinds (ADR-0011 section 10)

gdd_sync.old: | `cause` | ENDOGENOUS 0 / EXOGENOUS 1 | Last damage cause tag on the subject |
gdd_sync.new: | `cause` | ENDOGENOUS 0 / EXOGENOUS 1 | Last damage cause tag on the subject; persisted as the EXOGENOUS flag bit of the node/edge `flags` column (ADR-0011 section 3.2)

gdd_sync.old: `discarded_*`, `withdrawn_*` (M16, per medium)
gdd_sync.new: `discarded_*`, `withdrawn_*` (M16, per medium: gas mGU, coolant mL, fuel mL, energy dJ; sixteen int64 counters per section with the eight named above, ADR-0011 section 3.7)

gdd_sync.old: `EMPTY` (`default_state()`: no sections, counters at 1, `last_step_no` 0)
gdd_sync.new: `EMPTY` (`default_state()`: the EXTERIOR node row (id 0, section 0), no sections, counters at 1, `last_step_no` 0; ADR-0011 section 4.6)

gdd_sync.old: a virtual hole of `A_CUT` 24 is attached to each side's compartment as a hull stub with `hp` 2500
gdd_sync.new: a hull stub with `hp` 2500 and `A_CUT` 24 is attached to each side's compartment; each stub is an appended HULL_SEGMENT node row (flag STUB) listed in the SeamRecord's `stub_ids`, so no new persisted record type exists (ADR-0011 section 3.6)

gdd_sync.old: `instantiate_section` → `{node_base, edge_base, comp_base}`
gdd_sync.new: `instantiate_section` → `{node_base, edge_base, comp_base}`: node ids are allocated contiguously in template order with COMPARTMENT nodes first, so `comp_base == node_base` and `cid(room k) == comp_base + k`; `section_id` 0 is reserved for EXTERIOR (ADR-0011 section 4.4)

gdd_sync.old: spawns, despawns and re-selects size and behaviour on `F/` and `N/`
gdd_sync.new: spawns, despawns and re-selects size and behaviour on `F/` (the Graph's DESC kind, one key per subject) and `N/` (the Graph's NODE and EDGE kinds)

foundation_asks.ask: Add a config-driven field-writer rule OWN-01 (tools/lint/config/field_writers.json: class, member_prefix, writer_files, reader_files) that exempts the listed files from ARCH-06 for that prefix and flags assignment or mutating calls on such members elsewhere. Needed for TR-lsg-002; ARCH-06 as written forbids the foreign ._member access the Graph writer files need.

State in SIM-04 that the typed builtins mini, maxi, clampi, absi and signi are permitted in src/sim (it bans only the untyped min/max/clamp/abs/sign; the typed forms were probed to exist and return int on 4.7.2). Also record that if S1 shows IntMath.floor_div is material in the Graph phases, an inlined proven-non-negative form in named hot files is the sanctioned amendment route.

Add tools/lint/config/forbidden_symbols/graph.json as the READ-03 token list for src/sim/graph and src/sim/suit, naming MAX_DIRTY_KEYS, TICK_RATE, HYPOXIA_PP, DECOMP_P, COLD_DMG_ONSET_MC and HEAT_DMG_ONSET_MC (TR-lsg-043 mechanism).

In section 3, replace the 'loop in the high 16 bits and anchor in the low 16' packing example with owner-defined and range-checked composite packing; the Graph uses loop in the high 8 bits and anchor in the low 24 because 16 bits would be exhausted by VS-A id churn.

Accept a Graph ids.lock.json (assets/data/graph/, one space per persisted enum) under its ledger mechanism, since section 3.2 says the code-side enums need no ledger but assigns their stability to ADR-0011; append GRAPH_BOOT_COLUMN_RANGE and the GRAPH_LINT_* names to ContentFaults / the CI lint list.

Confirm that the Save/Load type walk accepts a nested Dictionary of packed arrays to depth 3 with String keys, and that a Graph restore needs no REBASED cause because the over-cap stock reconcile runs in the first phase 0 rather than in post_restore.

decisions.chosen: One graph.state block held as four RefCounted classes: GraphState (persisted SoA), GraphCaches (derived), GraphScratch, GraphDiag
decisions.reason: Makes TR-lsg-038 a one-line reflection test (GraphState members are payload columns or three holder refs) and zero-and-diff exhaustive; two-block split rejected per GDD R2 (a weld writes both).

decisions.chosen: Seven tables (nodes, ports, edges, comps, seams, sections, queues) plus defs CSR pair and hdr; ports are a CSR run (port_first/port_count) per node
decisions.reason: Port counts vary widely so a fixed MAX_PORTS_PER_NODE wastes or caps content; the run keeps the table dense and never moves since ports are allocated with the node.

decisions.chosen: cid is the node id of the COMPARTMENT node (kind 1); atmosphere lives in a parallel comps table; EXTERIOR is node 0 with no comps row; M1 allocates COMPARTMENT nodes first so comp_base == node_base
decisions.reason: One id space so OPENING edges can name compartments as endpoints; keeps M1's {node_base, edge_base, comp_base} shape and Layout's graph_ref_base; layout_room_ref/node 0 constraints from the GDD.

decisions.chosen: int64 for conserved/extensive quantities and counters; int32 for ids, step stamps, bp, permille, W and short physical quantities; uint8 for enums and flags; range-check before any 32/8-bit store
decisions.reason: LS-1(a) and D.13 maxima; silent 32-bit truncation (ADR-0005 P9, P17; probe g).

decisions.chosen: Every persisted stamp is in Graph steps; step_no() = IntMath.floor_div(clock.tick(), GRAPH_STEP_TICKS); hdr.last_step_no persisted separately
decisions.reason: TR-itemdb-014 and FT-15 compare against step_no; kernel ticks never stored.

decisions.chosen: No file-level integer_division ignore; all division via IntMath; remedy for cost deferred to S1 and an ADR-0010 amendment
decisions.reason: ADR-0010 SIM-04/SIM-05 and PRJ-04 allow exactly one ignore in IntMath.trunc_div; contradicts GDD LS-1(d), recorded as gdd_sync; floor_div ~12x bare operator (ADR-0005 P14).

decisions.chosen: Typed builtins mini, maxi, clampi, absi, signi
decisions.reason: Probed 2026-10-29 to exist and return int; SIM-04 bans only the untyped names; foundation ask 2.

decisions.chosen: One String-keyed Dictionary with hdr plus a nested Dictionary per table mapping column name to a duplicate() of the packed column; schema fingerprint committed
decisions.reason: Sorted-key hash order applies per level; StringName keys are rejected by the ADR-0006 walk and round-trip as StringName (probe h); renames are a schema_version bump.

decisions.chosen: hdr is a Dictionary of eight named ints, not a packed array of slots
decisions.reason: Restore diffs name the key; eight values do not justify a slot-order document; ADR-0005 3.6 threshold concerns row arrays.

decisions.chosen: Overloaded payload columns (stock, req, req_max, aux_a, aux_b, tier, subtype) with a normative overlay and named accessors, instead of per-kind side tables
decisions.reason: Avoids five row-index maps and tables for a ~2.7 KB saving at ~105 nodes; side table named as a size lever only.

decisions.chosen: Flag bit 0 in the flags byte, distinct from state (SALVAGED is a live state); tombstoned rows keep id, kind, section_id and zero everything else; restore validates canonical zeros
decisions.reason: LS-10 distinguishes SALVAGED from discarded; canonical zeros give one encoding per state.

decisions.chosen: Four append-only counters, ascending-id dense rows, no compaction in MVP, persisted refs are ids with derived id-to-slot caches, ID_MAX 2^24, stale ids no-op
decisions.reason: LS-1(i), TR-lsg-027/028; no code may assume id equals slot so VS-A compaction changes allocator and cache only.

decisions.chosen: GraphIds code constants plus a committed assets/data/graph/ids.lock.json in the ADR-0007 ledger format, checked by LedgerCheck and the append-only CI gate
decisions.reason: ADR-0007 gives stability to ADR-0011 and no ledger; persisted enums reach saves; reuses existing machinery (foundation ask).

decisions.point: Hull stubs of a RAGGED cut
decisions.chosen: Appended HULL_SEGMENT node rows with a STUB flag, listed in the SeamRecord's stub_ids; can_detach must include CAPACITY
decisions.reason: Satisfies the GDD's 'no new persisted field' via existing columns; Layout GDD already lists CAPACITY in can_detach.

decisions.chosen: Four media (gas mGU, coolant mL, fuel mL, energy dJ) giving sixteen int64 section counters
decisions.reason: M16 is legal on a BATTERY in dJ and M6 discards battery stock; GDD sync asks the owner to confirm.

decisions.chosen: Closed S0-a for the data model: packed arrays alias by reference (ADR-0005 P7, probes c,d); next arrays live in GraphScratch and are swapped by reference; a snapshot is a duplicate(), never a local alias; ADR-0012 owns which columns and when
decisions.reason: Probed allocation-free swap; duplicate() is deferred copy-on-write (probe e).

decisions.point: Over-cap store on restore (TR-itemdb-033 vs LS-21)
decisions.chosen: Hard ceilings are GraphTuning physical maxima, not the catalog stock_cap; stock above a lowered live cap restores exactly and a stock reconcile at the head of every phase 0 clamps, credits disc_*, counts stock_clamped (not a saturation)
decisions.reason: Keeps snapshot(restore(x)) byte-identical and needs no REBASED cause; ADR-0016 may overrule (Open Question 2).

decisions.chosen: Twelve fixed steps, first failure wins, each mapped to one GRAPH_RESTORE_* reason; room-dependent checks (UNKNOWN_ROOM, n_max) in post_restore
decisions.reason: Deterministic reason per corrupt input for the 1,000-mutation fuzz; V comes from Layout, restored first.

decisions.chosen: Domain 3 local codes 1..24 (NOT_IN_SCOPE kept from ADR-0003, 13 RESTORE_*, 6 STRUCT_*, ID_SPACE_EXHAUSTED, DESC_STORE_OVERFLOW, STEP_RANGE, SATURATION); GRAPH_BOOT_* are domain-2 names; GraphFault.raise_in(scope, code, subject) statics
decisions.reason: ADR-0003 section 6 delegates the code list here; ADR-0007 section 2.3 puts boot errors in domain 2; GDD spelling lacked the scope argument.

decisions.chosen: Clamp + saturations[field] in release; GraphFaults.SATURATION under injected strict_numeric (tests, STRICT_DEBUG)
decisions.reason: LS-24 two tiers; build-mode equivalence holds on a clean stream.

decisions.chosen: Columnar store built in strictly ascending key order by construction, key = (subject_kind<<40)|(subject_id<<8)|mode, no sort
decisions.reason: ADR-0005 1.6 bans sort_custom; fixed visit order makes 'sorted' a property of construction; debug asserts ascent.

decisions.chosen: Caller-owned PackedInt32Array of store row indices plus count; FailureFilter with kind/mode/medium masks, section, compartment, min_sev, consequence_only, alarm_only, loaded_only
decisions.reason: A filtered result is non-contiguous so a slice cannot be a range; zero allocation per call (TR-lsg-019).

decisions.chosen: Kinds COMP 1..SECTION 9; L/ id = (loop<<24)|anchor; F/ keyed per subject as (subject_kind<<28)|id; N/ shared by NODE and EDGE kinds; quiet_writes_allowed true; buckets via floor_div, seeds in post_restore
decisions.reason: LS-20 delegated the packing here; 16-bit anchor would be exhausted by id churn; F per subject can only reduce key count.

decisions.chosen: Graph publishes true_value(LOAD_PM) with dead/idle/overload cases
decisions.reason: TR-instr-027 requires a Graph-published value; a second formula in Instruments would be a second source of truth (LS-19 changes).

decisions.chosen: Underscore-prefixed columns written only in graph_mutators/propagate/restore; caches only in graph_derived; enforced by a new config-driven OWN-01 plus an ARCH-06 exemption (foundation ask)
decisions.reason: No existing ADR-0010 rule expresses it and ARCH-06 forbids foreign ._member access.

decisions.chosen: Tunables via frozen GraphTuning lowercase accessors equal to registry LOCKED rows; six registry/kernel names forbidden as symbols in src/sim/graph and src/sim/suit via READ-03 token list
decisions.reason: Existing READ-03 mechanism suffices; one source of truth.

decisions.chosen: Column-by-column table: hp, hp_cap, patched_at ride the arguments; stock to disc_* and 0 on install; setpoints take fresh defaults; state re-derived from hp; waste_permille/out_w_rated read live via def_ix
decisions.reason: TR-itemdb-016/031/040 and IDB-18; reinstall never raises hp or clears an hp-caused failure.

decisions.chosen: 29.7 KB at 105 nodes/150 edges (probed synthetic fixture); levers: fluid-stamp side table (~1.8 KB), merge stamps, ask owner to raise the 32 KB ceiling
decisions.reason: TR-lsg-036 ceiling is ADR-0012's but the column count is this ADR's; ~7% headroom, a fourth derelict does not fit.

cross_adr_assumptions.assumption: Builds the descriptor store in phase 11 in the column layout and ascending-key order defined here; reads the last-emitted bucket seeds written in post_restore; includes the stock reconcile at the head of phase 0; owns can_join semantics and may only add output (res_*) fields to JoinPlan; owns which columns are double-buffered and when the swap happens using GraphScratch; owns topology refresh contents of GraphCaches.

Namespaces the keyed-RNG subject_id (thaw-burst) because node and edge ids overlap numerically (a node 5 and edge 5 would draw identically); also decides inlining of hot IntMath divisions after spike S1.

Layout allocates section_id and room_id (real section ids start at 1; 0 is the world EXTERIOR); M1 takes section_id as an argument and the Graph allocates node/edge/seam ids and returns {node_base, edge_base, comp_base}; Layout stores graph_ref_base as plain ids; templates list COMPARTMENT nodes first in room order; Layout's read view implements the RoomSource port and layout_room_ref is Layout's block-local room id.

graph.state restores after layout.state; post_restore runs after Layout's restore with cross-block reads allowed; a faulted post_restore (LOADING to FAULTED) never lets the restored world enter play; may relocate the stock reconcile to post_restore (then owing ADR-0006 a REBASED cause).

Calls weld_join/install_module/salvage_node/cut_detach inside Assembly's apply with pooled caller-owned JoinPlan/WeldResult/SalvageRecord objects; JoinPlan input fields are fixed by this ADR; can_detach includes CAPACITY because a RAGGED cut appends stub rows; orders the salvage/reinstall mutator calls per the section 5 column table.
Reads served_pm, run_pm and node state through the typed GraphView getters and failures(filter, out) at Graph ticks, with no subscription.
Perception Filter is the only non-diagnostic caller of true_value and wraps the published kinds P, P_O2, T, STOCK_PM, SUPPLY, DEMAND, LOAD_PM, HP.
Web Map calls M19 set_section_dormant and M1 inside its INIT scope; the dormant stamps (dormant_since, advanced step stamps) are the columns defined here.
Suit calls M15 draw_air and M16 withdraw_store through the declared Class B paths; the pending_draw queue and draw_grant table are the storage defined here.
The ambient mean uses served_pm(id) and nodes_in(cid, out) over Graph LOAD nodes only; self-powered fixtures are not Graph nodes.

open_questions: IntMath.floor_div costs about 12x a bare operator; if spike S1 shows it matters in the Graph phases, ADR-0010 must sanction an inlined non-negative form in named hot files (owner ADR-0010 / S1).
Where the over-cap stock reconcile runs: this ADR chooses phase 0 of the first run (restore stays byte-identical); ADR-0016 may prefer post_restore and then owes ADR-0006 a REBASED cause.
The GDD does not name `cause` as persisted (LS-3 common fields); stored here as the EXOGENOUS flag bit, GDD should confirm.
The fourth medium (energy, dJ) in discarded_*/withdrawn_* follows from M16 on a BATTERY; GDD should confirm.
Registry gaps for capacities: pending-load bound (64, TR-lsg-017), JOIN_PAIRS_MAX/JOIN_OPENINGS_MAX (placeholders 16/4), max_stock_gas, max_stock_liquid.
LOAD_QUANTUM_PERMILLE is absent from design/registry/entities.yaml.
The Failure & Trail and Emitter GDDs name the F/<id> dirty-key family; this ADR reads it as the DESC kind keyed per subject.
Node/edge id numeric overlap in ADR-0012's keyed RNG subject field must be namespaced.
32 KB snapshot ceiling has about 7% headroom at the full MVP loaded set; release-export measurement (S3) pending and levers are listed.
VS-A compaction would renumber ids held by Layout bases, Interaction subjects and Perception refs; needs a remap or indirection in its own ADR.

toolu_015ShZAASDUrdouGzrGvGUs4.summary: ADR-0011 (Proposed, 2026-10-29) fixes the Life-Support Graph data model. graph.state is one SIM block held as four RefCounted classes: GraphState (persisted SoA), GraphCaches (derived), GraphScratch and GraphDiag. The persisted state is seven tables (nodes, ports as a CSR run per node, edges, comps, seams, sections, queues) plus a def-name CSR pair and a hdr Dictionary of ints. Columns are int64 for conserved quantities and counters, int32 for ids, step stamps, bp, permille and W, and uint8 for enums and flags. All stamps are in Graph steps. Division goes only through IntMath; there is no file-level integer_division ignore, and mini/maxi/clampi/absi/signi are used (probed). Ids are append-only with derived id-to-slot maps, tombstone flag bits and no compaction. cid is the COMPARTMENT node id. Type enums are code constants locked by an ids.lock.json ledger. The ADR gives a salvage/install column-policy table, a persisted/derived/scratch/diagnostic classification checked by reflection plus zero-and-diff, a nested String-keyed payload with a fingerprint, a 12-step first-failure-wins restore order, 24 domain-3 fault codes, and domain-2 boot codes. It also specifies the pure GraphView with LOAD_PM, a columnar descriptor store built in ascending key order, the dirty-key kinds and 8/24 packing, and the shared value types JoinPlan, WeldResult, FailureFilter, FailureSlice, SalvageRecord, InstantiateResult and the RoomSource port. A store above a lowered stock_cap restores exactly and is reconciled in the first phase 0. Probed size is 29.7 KB for 105 nodes/150 edges against the 32 KB ceiling (about 7% headroom, which a fourth derelict would exceed). Five foundation asks and eight GDD syncs are listed.

registry_candidates.name: existing entries gaining ADR-0011
registry_candidates.entry_yaml:
- fault_domain_table (state_ownership, ADR-0003): add adr-0011 (domain 3 local code list written here)
- block_persistence_payload (interfaces, ADR-0006): add adr-0011 (nested String-keyed Dictionary of duplicated columns; restore precedence)
- dirty_key_encoding (api_decisions, ADR-0004): add adr-0011 (Graph kinds and the L/ and F/ packing)
- id_ledgers (state_ownership, ADR-0007): add adr-0011 (graph ids.lock.json spaces)
- foreign_private_member_access (forbidden_patterns, ADR-0010): add adr-0011 (writer/reader file exemption request)
- packed_array_exposed_or_setter_tracked (forbidden_patterns, ADR-0010): add adr-0011 (alarm_sections and failures use caller-owned buffers)
- integer_division_convention (api_decisions, ADR-0005): add adr-0011 (no file-level ignore in src/sim/graph)

gdd_sync.old: each file of `src/sim/graph/` opens with `@warning_ignore_start("integer_division")`, because every flux division is intentional integer division and would otherwise flood the editor with warnings; S0-b verifies that this annotation exists in 4.7.2 and silences the warning
gdd_sync.new: no file in `src/sim/graph/` carries an `integer_division` ignore: every division goes through `IntMath.floor_div`/`ceil_div`/`trunc_div` (ADR-0005 section 1.4; ADR-0010 SIM-04/SIM-05 allow exactly one ignore, in `IntMath.trunc_div`); S0-b no longer verifies the annotation (ADR-0011 section 2.3)

gdd_sync.old: every field is underscore-prefixed and a lint forbids writes outside the four writer files `graph_mutators.gd`, `graph_propagate.gd`, `graph_restore.gd` (decode, validate, swap) and `graph_derived.gd` (non-persisted caches only)
gdd_sync.new: every persisted column of `GraphState` is underscore-prefixed and written only in `graph_mutators.gd`, `graph_propagate.gd` and `graph_restore.gd`; derived caches, scratch buffers and diagnostics are the separate classes `GraphCaches` (written only by `graph_derived.gd`), `GraphScratch` and `GraphDiag`, and the DERIVED allowlist of the reflection test is the member list of those classes (ADR-0011 sections 1, 6.3, 12.1)

gdd_sync.old: Every check is raised through `GraphFault.raise(code, subject)`, which records the code, returns the failure to the kernel and, in debug, also halts
gdd_sync.new: Every check is raised through `GraphFault.raise_in(scope, code, subject)` (or `raise_ctx(ctx, code, subject, detail)` in restore and post_restore), which faults the scope or context with a domain-3 code and returns -code; the debug halt is the kernel's FAULTED dev rule (ADR-0011 section 8.2)

gdd_sync.old: a numeric *soft* violation in play is a *hard* failure on load, because a corrupt save must not be "fixed" into a different world
gdd_sync.new: a numeric soft violation in play is a hard failure on load against the physical ceilings in `GraphTuning`; a store above a lowered live catalog `stock_cap` is not a violation: it restores exactly and the first phase 0 clamps it, credits `discarded_*`, counts `stock_clamped` (not a saturation) and emits a diagnostic (ADR-0011 section 7.3; TR-itemdb-033)

gdd_sync.old: Instruments' `load = ⌊1000 × demand / max(1, supply)⌋` is its own reading, not `ρ`, and reads no `cap`
gdd_sync.new: the Graph publishes `true_value(LOAD_PM)` = 0 when `supply` is 0, else `min(1250, floor(1000 × demand / supply))`, with dead/idle/overload cases from `power_component_case`; Instruments reads it and derives nothing (ADR-0011 section 9.2; TR-instr-027)

gdd_sync.old: `alarm_sections()` → ascending, duplicate-free `section_id`s
gdd_sync.new: `alarm_sections(out: PackedInt32Array) -> int` fills a caller-owned buffer with ascending, duplicate-free `section_id`s and returns the count; the other list queries (`nodes_in`, `neighbors`, `open_ends`, `hull_segments_of`) use caller-owned buffers the same way; `step_no()` is `floor_div(T, GRAPH_STEP_TICKS)` (ADR-0011 section 9.1)

gdd_sync.old: (the packing and its range check are fixed by ADR-0011)
gdd_sync.new: composite packing is `(loop << 24) | anchor` with the anchor below `ID_MAX` 2^24; `F/<id>` is the DESC kind keyed per subject as `(subject_kind << 28) | subject_id`; `N/<id>` is the family of both the NODE and EDGE kinds (ADR-0011 section 10)

gdd_sync.old: | `cause` | ENDOGENOUS 0 / EXOGENOUS 1 | Last damage cause tag on the subject |
gdd_sync.new: | `cause` | ENDOGENOUS 0 / EXOGENOUS 1 | Last damage cause tag on the subject; persisted as the EXOGENOUS flag bit of the node/edge `flags` column (ADR-0011 section 3.2)

gdd_sync.old: `discarded_*`, `withdrawn_*` (M16, per medium)
gdd_sync.new: `discarded_*`, `withdrawn_*` (M16, per medium: gas mGU, coolant mL, fuel mL, energy dJ; sixteen int64 counters per section with the eight named above, ADR-0011 section 3.7)

gdd_sync.old: `EMPTY` (`default_state()`: no sections, counters at 1, `last_step_no` 0)
gdd_sync.new: `EMPTY` (`default_state()`: the EXTERIOR node row (id 0, section 0), no sections, counters at 1, `last_step_no` 0; ADR-0011 section 4.6)

gdd_sync.old: a virtual hole of `A_CUT` 24 is attached to each side's compartment as a hull stub with `hp` 2500
gdd_sync.new: a hull stub with `hp` 2500 and `A_CUT` 24 is attached to each side's compartment; each stub is an appended HULL_SEGMENT node row (flag STUB) listed in the SeamRecord's `stub_ids`, so no new persisted record type exists (ADR-0011 section 3.6)

gdd_sync.old: `instantiate_section` → `{node_base, edge_base, comp_base}`
gdd_sync.new: `instantiate_section` → `{node_base, edge_base, comp_base}`: node ids are allocated contiguously in template order with COMPARTMENT nodes first, so `comp_base == node_base` and `cid(room k) == comp_base + k`; `section_id` 0 is reserved for EXTERIOR (ADR-0011 section 4.4)

gdd_sync.old: spawns, despawns and re-selects size and behaviour on `F/` and `N/`
gdd_sync.new: spawns, despawns and re-selects size and behaviour on `F/` (the Graph's DESC kind, one key per subject) and `N/` (the Graph's NODE and EDGE kinds)

foundation_asks.ask: Add a config-driven field-writer rule OWN-01 (tools/lint/config/field_writers.json: class, member_prefix, writer_files, reader_files) that exempts the listed files from ARCH-06 for that prefix and flags assignment or mutating calls on such members elsewhere. Needed for TR-lsg-002; ARCH-06 as written forbids the foreign ._member access the Graph writer files need.

State in SIM-04 that the typed builtins mini, maxi, clampi, absi and signi are permitted in src/sim (it bans only the untyped min/max/clamp/abs/sign; the typed forms were probed to exist and return int on 4.7.2). Also record that if S1 shows IntMath.floor_div is material in the Graph phases, an inlined proven-non-negative form in named hot files is the sanctioned amendment route.

Add tools/lint/config/forbidden_symbols/graph.json as the READ-03 token list for src/sim/graph and src/sim/suit, naming MAX_DIRTY_KEYS, TICK_RATE, HYPOXIA_PP, DECOMP_P, COLD_DMG_ONSET_MC and HEAT_DMG_ONSET_MC (TR-lsg-043 mechanism).

In section 3, replace the 'loop in the high 16 bits and anchor in the low 16' packing example with owner-defined and range-checked composite packing; the Graph uses loop in the high 8 bits and anchor in the low 24 because 16 bits would be exhausted by VS-A id churn.

Accept a Graph ids.lock.json (assets/data/graph/, one space per persisted enum) under its ledger mechanism, since section 3.2 says the code-side enums need no ledger but assigns their stability to ADR-0011; append GRAPH_BOOT_COLUMN_RANGE and the GRAPH_LINT_* names to ContentFaults / the CI lint list.

Confirm that the Save/Load type walk accepts a nested Dictionary of packed arrays to depth 3 with String keys, and that a Graph restore needs no REBASED cause because the over-cap stock reconcile runs in the first phase 0 rather than in post_restore.

decisions.chosen: One graph.state block held as four RefCounted classes: GraphState (persisted SoA), GraphCaches (derived), GraphScratch, GraphDiag
decisions.reason: Makes TR-lsg-038 a one-line reflection test (GraphState members are payload columns or three holder refs) and zero-and-diff exhaustive; two-block split rejected per GDD R2 (a weld writes both).

decisions.chosen: Seven tables (nodes, ports, edges, comps, seams, sections, queues) plus defs CSR pair and hdr; ports are a CSR run (port_first/port_count) per node
decisions.reason: Port counts vary widely so a fixed MAX_PORTS_PER_NODE wastes or caps content; the run keeps the table dense and never moves since ports are allocated with the node.

decisions.chosen: cid is the node id of the COMPARTMENT node (kind 1); atmosphere lives in a parallel comps table; EXTERIOR is node 0 with no comps row; M1 allocates COMPARTMENT nodes first so comp_base == node_base
decisions.reason: One id space so OPENING edges can name compartments as endpoints; keeps M1's {node_base, edge_base, comp_base} shape and Layout's graph_ref_base; layout_room_ref/node 0 constraints from the GDD.

decisions.chosen: int64 for conserved/extensive quantities and counters; int32 for ids, step stamps, bp, permille, W and short physical quantities; uint8 for enums and flags; range-check before any 32/8-bit store
decisions.reason: LS-1(a) and D.13 maxima; silent 32-bit truncation (ADR-0005 P9, P17; probe g).

decisions.chosen: Every persisted stamp is in Graph steps; step_no() = IntMath.floor_div(clock.tick(), GRAPH_STEP_TICKS); hdr.last_step_no persisted separately
decisions.reason: TR-itemdb-014 and FT-15 compare against step_no; kernel ticks never stored.

decisions.chosen: No file-level integer_division ignore; all division via IntMath; remedy for cost deferred to S1 and an ADR-0010 amendment
decisions.reason: ADR-0010 SIM-04/SIM-05 and PRJ-04 allow exactly one ignore in IntMath.trunc_div; contradicts GDD LS-1(d), recorded as gdd_sync; floor_div ~12x bare operator (ADR-0005 P14).

decisions.chosen: Typed builtins mini, maxi, clampi, absi, signi
decisions.reason: Probed 2026-10-29 to exist and return int; SIM-04 bans only the untyped names; foundation ask 2.

decisions.chosen: One String-keyed Dictionary with hdr plus a nested Dictionary per table mapping column name to a duplicate() of the packed column; schema fingerprint committed
decisions.reason: Sorted-key hash order applies per level; StringName keys are rejected by the ADR-0006 walk and round-trip as StringName (probe h); renames are a schema_version bump.

decisions.chosen: hdr is a Dictionary of eight named ints, not a packed array of slots
decisions.reason: Restore diffs name the key; eight values do not justify a slot-order document; ADR-0005 3.6 threshold concerns row arrays.

decisions.chosen: Overloaded payload columns (stock, req, req_max, aux_a, aux_b, tier, subtype) with a normative overlay and named accessors, instead of per-kind side tables
decisions.reason: Avoids five row-index maps and tables for a ~2.7 KB saving at ~105 nodes; side table named as a size lever only.

decisions.chosen: Flag bit 0 in the flags byte, distinct from state (SALVAGED is a live state); tombstoned rows keep id, kind, section_id and zero everything else; restore validates canonical zeros
decisions.reason: LS-10 distinguishes SALVAGED from discarded; canonical zeros give one encoding per state.

decisions.chosen: Four append-only counters, ascending-id dense rows, no compaction in MVP, persisted refs are ids with derived id-to-slot caches, ID_MAX 2^24, stale ids no-op
decisions.reason: LS-1(i), TR-lsg-027/028; no code may assume id equals slot so VS-A compaction changes allocator and cache only.

decisions.chosen: GraphIds code constants plus a committed assets/data/graph/ids.lock.json in the ADR-0007 ledger format, checked by LedgerCheck and the append-only CI gate
decisions.reason: ADR-0007 gives stability to ADR-0011 and no ledger; persisted enums reach saves; reuses existing machinery (foundation ask).

decisions.point: Hull stubs of a RAGGED cut
decisions.chosen: Appended HULL_SEGMENT node rows with a STUB flag, listed in the SeamRecord's stub_ids; can_detach must include CAPACITY
decisions.reason: Satisfies the GDD's 'no new persisted field' via existing columns; Layout GDD already lists CAPACITY in can_detach.

decisions.chosen: Four media (gas mGU, coolant mL, fuel mL, energy dJ) giving sixteen int64 section counters
decisions.reason: M16 is legal on a BATTERY in dJ and M6 discards battery stock; GDD sync asks the owner to confirm.

decisions.chosen: Closed S0-a for the data model: packed arrays alias by reference (ADR-0005 P7, probes c,d); next arrays live in GraphScratch and are swapped by reference; a snapshot is a duplicate(), never a local alias; ADR-0012 owns which columns and when
decisions.reason: Probed allocation-free swap; duplicate() is deferred copy-on-write (probe e).

decisions.point: Over-cap store on restore (TR-itemdb-033 vs LS-21)
decisions.chosen: Hard ceilings are GraphTuning physical maxima, not the catalog stock_cap; stock above a lowered live cap restores exactly and a stock reconcile at the head of every phase 0 clamps, credits disc_*, counts stock_clamped (not a saturation)
decisions.reason: Keeps snapshot(restore(x)) byte-identical and needs no REBASED cause; ADR-0016 may overrule (Open Question 2).

decisions.chosen: Twelve fixed steps, first failure wins, each mapped to one GRAPH_RESTORE_* reason; room-dependent checks (UNKNOWN_ROOM, n_max) in post_restore
decisions.reason: Deterministic reason per corrupt input for the 1,000-mutation fuzz; V comes from Layout, restored first.

decisions.chosen: Domain 3 local codes 1..24 (NOT_IN_SCOPE kept from ADR-0003, 13 RESTORE_*, 6 STRUCT_*, ID_SPACE_EXHAUSTED, DESC_STORE_OVERFLOW, STEP_RANGE, SATURATION); GRAPH_BOOT_* are domain-2 names; GraphFault.raise_in(scope, code, subject) statics
decisions.reason: ADR-0003 section 6 delegates the code list here; ADR-0007 section 2.3 puts boot errors in domain 2; GDD spelling lacked the scope argument.

decisions.chosen: Clamp + saturations[field] in release; GraphFaults.SATURATION under injected strict_numeric (tests, STRICT_DEBUG)
decisions.reason: LS-24 two tiers; build-mode equivalence holds on a clean stream.

decisions.chosen: Columnar store built in strictly ascending key order by construction, key = (subject_kind<<40)|(subject_id<<8)|mode, no sort
decisions.reason: ADR-0005 1.6 bans sort_custom; fixed visit order makes 'sorted' a property of construction; debug asserts ascent.

decisions.chosen: Caller-owned PackedInt32Array of store row indices plus count; FailureFilter with kind/mode/medium masks, section, compartment, min_sev, consequence_only, alarm_only, loaded_only
decisions.reason: A filtered result is non-contiguous so a slice cannot be a range; zero allocation per call (TR-lsg-019).

decisions.chosen: Kinds COMP 1..SECTION 9; L/ id = (loop<<24)|anchor; F/ keyed per subject as (subject_kind<<28)|id; N/ shared by NODE and EDGE kinds; quiet_writes_allowed true; buckets via floor_div, seeds in post_restore
decisions.reason: LS-20 delegated the packing here; 16-bit anchor would be exhausted by id churn; F per subject can only reduce key count.

decisions.chosen: Graph publishes true_value(LOAD_PM) with dead/idle/overload cases
decisions.reason: TR-instr-027 requires a Graph-published value; a second formula in Instruments would be a second source of truth (LS-19 changes).

decisions.chosen: Underscore-prefixed columns written only in graph_mutators/propagate/restore; caches only in graph_derived; enforced by a new config-driven OWN-01 plus an ARCH-06 exemption (foundation ask)
decisions.reason: No existing ADR-0010 rule expresses it and ARCH-06 forbids foreign ._member access.

decisions.chosen: Tunables via frozen GraphTuning lowercase accessors equal to registry LOCKED rows; six registry/kernel names forbidden as symbols in src/sim/graph and src/sim/suit via READ-03 token list
decisions.reason: Existing READ-03 mechanism suffices; one source of truth.

decisions.chosen: Column-by-column table: hp, hp_cap, patched_at ride the arguments; stock to disc_* and 0 on install; setpoints take fresh defaults; state re-derived from hp; waste_permille/out_w_rated read live via def_ix
decisions.reason: TR-itemdb-016/031/040 and IDB-18; reinstall never raises hp or clears an hp-caused failure.

decisions.chosen: 29.7 KB at 105 nodes/150 edges (probed synthetic fixture); levers: fluid-stamp side table (~1.8 KB), merge stamps, ask owner to raise the 32 KB ceiling
decisions.reason: TR-lsg-036 ceiling is ADR-0012's but the column count is this ADR's; ~7% headroom, a fourth derelict does not fit.

cross_adr_assumptions.assumption: Builds the descriptor store in phase 11 in the column layout and ascending-key order defined here; reads the last-emitted bucket seeds written in post_restore; includes the stock reconcile at the head of phase 0; owns can_join semantics and may only add output (res_*) fields to JoinPlan; owns which columns are double-buffered and when the swap happens using GraphScratch; owns topology refresh contents of GraphCaches.

Namespaces the keyed-RNG subject_id (thaw-burst) because node and edge ids overlap numerically (a node 5 and edge 5 would draw identically); also decides inlining of hot IntMath divisions after spike S1.

Layout allocates section_id and room_id (real section ids start at 1; 0 is the world EXTERIOR); M1 takes section_id as an argument and the Graph allocates node/edge/seam ids and returns {node_base, edge_base, comp_base}; Layout stores graph_ref_base as plain ids; templates list COMPARTMENT nodes first in room order; Layout's read view implements the RoomSource port and layout_room_ref is Layout's block-local room id.

graph.state restores after layout.state; post_restore runs after Layout's restore with cross-block reads allowed; a faulted post_restore (LOADING to FAULTED) never lets the restored world enter play; may relocate the stock reconcile to post_restore (then owing ADR-0006 a REBASED cause).

Calls weld_join/install_module/salvage_node/cut_detach inside Assembly's apply with pooled caller-owned JoinPlan/WeldResult/SalvageRecord objects; JoinPlan input fields are fixed by this ADR; can_detach includes CAPACITY because a RAGGED cut appends stub rows; orders the salvage/reinstall mutator calls per the section 5 column table.
Reads served_pm, run_pm and node state through the typed GraphView getters and failures(filter, out) at Graph ticks, with no subscription.
Perception Filter is the only non-diagnostic caller of true_value and wraps the published kinds P, P_O2, T, STOCK_PM, SUPPLY, DEMAND, LOAD_PM, HP.
Web Map calls M19 set_section_dormant and M1 inside its INIT scope; the dormant stamps (dormant_since, advanced step stamps) are the columns defined here.
Suit calls M15 draw_air and M16 withdraw_store through the declared Class B paths; the pending_draw queue and draw_grant table are the storage defined here.
The ambient mean uses served_pm(id) and nodes_in(cid, out) over Graph LOAD nodes only; self-powered fixtures are not Graph nodes.

open_questions: IntMath.floor_div costs about 12x a bare operator; if spike S1 shows it matters in the Graph phases, ADR-0010 must sanction an inlined non-negative form in named hot files (owner ADR-0010 / S1).
Where the over-cap stock reconcile runs: this ADR chooses phase 0 of the first run (restore stays byte-identical); ADR-0016 may prefer post_restore and then owes ADR-0006 a REBASED cause.
The GDD does not name `cause` as persisted (LS-3 common fields); stored here as the EXOGENOUS flag bit, GDD should confirm.
The fourth medium (energy, dJ) in discarded_*/withdrawn_* follows from M16 on a BATTERY; GDD should confirm.
Registry gaps for capacities: pending-load bound (64, TR-lsg-017), JOIN_PAIRS_MAX/JOIN_OPENINGS_MAX (placeholders 16/4), max_stock_gas, max_stock_liquid.
LOAD_QUANTUM_PERMILLE is absent from design/registry/entities.yaml.
The Failure & Trail and Emitter GDDs name the F/<id> dirty-key family; this ADR reads it as the DESC kind keyed per subject.
Node/edge id numeric overlap in ADR-0012's keyed RNG subject field must be namespaced.
32 KB snapshot ceiling has about 7% headroom at the full MVP loaded set; release-export measurement (S3) pending and levers are listed.
VS-A compaction would renumber ids held by Layout bases, Interaction subjects and Perception refs; needs a remap or indirection in its own ADR.

data.summary: ADR-0011 (Proposed, 2026-10-29) fixes the Life-Support Graph data model. graph.state is one SIM block held as four RefCounted classes: GraphState (persisted SoA), GraphCaches (derived), GraphScratch and GraphDiag. The persisted state is seven tables (nodes, ports as a CSR run per node, edges, comps, seams, sections, queues) plus a def-name CSR pair and a hdr Dictionary of ints. Columns are int64 for conserved quantities and counters, int32 for ids, step stamps, bp, permille and W, and uint8 for enums and flags. All stamps are in Graph steps. Division goes only through IntMath; there is no file-level integer_division ignore, and mini/maxi/clampi/absi/signi are used (probed). Ids are append-only with derived id-to-slot maps, tombstone flag bits and no compaction. cid is the COMPARTMENT node id. Type enums are code constants locked by an ids.lock.json ledger. The ADR gives a salvage/install column-policy table, a persisted/derived/scratch/diagnostic classification checked by reflection plus zero-and-diff, a nested String-keyed payload with a fingerprint, a 12-step first-failure-wins restore order, 24 domain-3 fault codes, and domain-2 boot codes. It also specifies the pure GraphView with LOAD_PM, a columnar descriptor store built in ascending key order, the dirty-key kinds and 8/24 packing, and the shared value types JoinPlan, WeldResult, FailureFilter, FailureSlice, SalvageRecord, InstantiateResult and the RoomSource port. A store above a lowered stock_cap restores exactly and is reconciled in the first phase 0. Probed size is 29.7 KB for 105 nodes/150 edges against the 32 KB ceiling (about 7% headroom, which a fourth derelict would exceed). Five foundation asks and eight GDD syncs are listed.

registry_candidates.name: existing entries gaining ADR-0011
registry_candidates.entry_yaml:
- fault_domain_table (state_ownership, ADR-0003): add adr-0011 (domain 3 local code list written here)
- block_persistence_payload (interfaces, ADR-0006): add adr-0011 (nested String-keyed Dictionary of duplicated columns; restore precedence)
- dirty_key_encoding (api_decisions, ADR-0004): add adr-0011 (Graph kinds and the L/ and F/ packing)
- id_ledgers (state_ownership, ADR-0007): add adr-0011 (graph ids.lock.json spaces)
- foreign_private_member_access (forbidden_patterns, ADR-0010): add adr-0011 (writer/reader file exemption request)
- packed_array_exposed_or_setter_tracked (forbidden_patterns, ADR-0010): add adr-0011 (alarm_sections and failures use caller-owned buffers)
- integer_division_convention (api_decisions, ADR-0005): add adr-0011 (no file-level ignore in src/sim/graph)

gdd_sync.old: each file of `src/sim/graph/` opens with `@warning_ignore_start("integer_division")`, because every flux division is intentional integer division and would otherwise flood the editor with warnings; S0-b verifies that this annotation exists in 4.7.2 and silences the warning
gdd_sync.new: no file in `src/sim/graph/` carries an `integer_division` ignore: every division goes through `IntMath.floor_div`/`ceil_div`/`trunc_div` (ADR-0005 section 1.4; ADR-0010 SIM-04/SIM-05 allow exactly one ignore, in `IntMath.trunc_div`); S0-b no longer verifies the annotation (ADR-0011 section 2.3)

gdd_sync.old: every field is underscore-prefixed and a lint forbids writes outside the four writer files `graph_mutators.gd`, `graph_propagate.gd`, `graph_restore.gd` (decode, validate, swap) and `graph_derived.gd` (non-persisted caches only)
gdd_sync.new: every persisted column of `GraphState` is underscore-prefixed and written only in `graph_mutators.gd`, `graph_propagate.gd` and `graph_restore.gd`; derived caches, scratch buffers and diagnostics are the separate classes `GraphCaches` (written only by `graph_derived.gd`), `GraphScratch` and `GraphDiag`, and the DERIVED allowlist of the reflection test is the member list of those classes (ADR-0011 sections 1, 6.3, 12.1)

gdd_sync.old: Every check is raised through `GraphFault.raise(code, subject)`, which records the code, returns the failure to the kernel and, in debug, also halts
gdd_sync.new: Every check is raised through `GraphFault.raise_in(scope, code, subject)` (or `raise_ctx(ctx, code, subject, detail)` in restore and post_restore), which faults the scope or context with a domain-3 code and returns -code; the debug halt is the kernel's FAULTED dev rule (ADR-0011 section 8.2)

gdd_sync.old: a numeric *soft* violation in play is a *hard* failure on load, because a corrupt save must not be "fixed" into a different world
gdd_sync.new: a numeric soft violation in play is a hard failure on load against the physical ceilings in `GraphTuning`; a store above a lowered live catalog `stock_cap` is not a violation: it restores exactly and the first phase 0 clamps it, credits `discarded_*`, counts `stock_clamped` (not a saturation) and emits a diagnostic (ADR-0011 section 7.3; TR-itemdb-033)

gdd_sync.old: Instruments' `load = ⌊1000 × demand / max(1, supply)⌋` is its own reading, not `ρ`, and reads no `cap`
gdd_sync.new: the Graph publishes `true_value(LOAD_PM)` = 0 when `supply` is 0, else `min(1250, floor(1000 × demand / supply))`, with dead/idle/overload cases from `power_component_case`; Instruments reads it and derives nothing (ADR-0011 section 9.2; TR-instr-027)

gdd_sync.old: `alarm_sections()` → ascending, duplicate-free `section_id`s
gdd_sync.new: `alarm_sections(out: PackedInt32Array) -> int` fills a caller-owned buffer with ascending, duplicate-free `section_id`s and returns the count; the other list queries (`nodes_in`, `neighbors`, `open_ends`, `hull_segments_of`) use caller-owned buffers the same way; `step_no()` is `floor_div(T, GRAPH_STEP_TICKS)` (ADR-0011 section 9.1)

gdd_sync.old: (the packing and its range check are fixed by ADR-0011)
gdd_sync.new: composite packing is `(loop << 24) | anchor` with the anchor below `ID_MAX` 2^24; `F/<id>` is the DESC kind keyed per subject as `(subject_kind << 28) | subject_id`; `N/<id>` is the family of both the NODE and EDGE kinds (ADR-0011 section 10)

gdd_sync.old: | `cause` | ENDOGENOUS 0 / EXOGENOUS 1 | Last damage cause tag on the subject |
gdd_sync.new: | `cause` | ENDOGENOUS 0 / EXOGENOUS 1 | Last damage cause tag on the subject; persisted as the EXOGENOUS flag bit of the node/edge `flags` column (ADR-0011 section 3.2)

gdd_sync.old: `discarded_*`, `withdrawn_*` (M16, per medium)
gdd_sync.new: `discarded_*`, `withdrawn_*` (M16, per medium: gas mGU, coolant mL, fuel mL, energy dJ; sixteen int64 counters per section with the eight named above, ADR-0011 section 3.7)

gdd_sync.old: `EMPTY` (`default_state()`: no sections, counters at 1, `last_step_no` 0)
gdd_sync.new: `EMPTY` (`default_state()`: the EXTERIOR node row (id 0, section 0), no sections, counters at 1, `last_step_no` 0; ADR-0011 section 4.6)

gdd_sync.old: a virtual hole of `A_CUT` 24 is attached to each side's compartment as a hull stub with `hp` 2500
gdd_sync.new: a hull stub with `hp` 2500 and `A_CUT` 24 is attached to each side's compartment; each stub is an appended HULL_SEGMENT node row (flag STUB) listed in the SeamRecord's `stub_ids`, so no new persisted record type exists (ADR-0011 section 3.6)

gdd_sync.old: `instantiate_section` → `{node_base, edge_base, comp_base}`
gdd_sync.new: `instantiate_section` → `{node_base, edge_base, comp_base}`: node ids are allocated contiguously in template order with COMPARTMENT nodes first, so `comp_base == node_base` and `cid(room k) == comp_base + k`; `section_id` 0 is reserved for EXTERIOR (ADR-0011 section 4.4)

gdd_sync.old: spawns, despawns and re-selects size and behaviour on `F/` and `N/`
gdd_sync.new: spawns, despawns and re-selects size and behaviour on `F/` (the Graph's DESC kind, one key per subject) and `N/` (the Graph's NODE and EDGE kinds)

foundation_asks.ask: Add a config-driven field-writer rule OWN-01 (tools/lint/config/field_writers.json: class, member_prefix, writer_files, reader_files) that exempts the listed files from ARCH-06 for that prefix and flags assignment or mutating calls on such members elsewhere. Needed for TR-lsg-002; ARCH-06 as written forbids the foreign ._member access the Graph writer files need.

State in SIM-04 that the typed builtins mini, maxi, clampi, absi and signi are permitted in src/sim (it bans only the untyped min/max/clamp/abs/sign; the typed forms were probed to exist and return int on 4.7.2). Also record that if S1 shows IntMath.floor_div is material in the Graph phases, an inlined proven-non-negative form in named hot files is the sanctioned amendment route.

Add tools/lint/config/forbidden_symbols/graph.json as the READ-03 token list for src/sim/graph and src/sim/suit, naming MAX_DIRTY_KEYS, TICK_RATE, HYPOXIA_PP, DECOMP_P, COLD_DMG_ONSET_MC and HEAT_DMG_ONSET_MC (TR-lsg-043 mechanism).

In section 3, replace the 'loop in the high 16 bits and anchor in the low 16' packing example with owner-defined and range-checked composite packing; the Graph uses loop in the high 8 bits and anchor in the low 24 because 16 bits would be exhausted by VS-A id churn.

Accept a Graph ids.lock.json (assets/data/graph/, one space per persisted enum) under its ledger mechanism, since section 3.2 says the code-side enums need no ledger but assigns their stability to ADR-0011; append GRAPH_BOOT_COLUMN_RANGE and the GRAPH_LINT_* names to ContentFaults / the CI lint list.

Confirm that the Save/Load type walk accepts a nested Dictionary of packed arrays to depth 3 with String keys, and that a Graph restore needs no REBASED cause because the over-cap stock reconcile runs in the first phase 0 rather than in post_restore.

decisions.chosen: One graph.state block held as four RefCounted classes: GraphState (persisted SoA), GraphCaches (derived), GraphScratch, GraphDiag
decisions.reason: Makes TR-lsg-038 a one-line reflection test (GraphState members are payload columns or three holder refs) and zero-and-diff exhaustive; two-block split rejected per GDD R2 (a weld writes both).

decisions.chosen: Seven tables (nodes, ports, edges, comps, seams, sections, queues) plus defs CSR pair and hdr; ports are a CSR run (port_first/port_count) per node
decisions.reason: Port counts vary widely so a fixed MAX_PORTS_PER_NODE wastes or caps content; the run keeps the table dense and never moves since ports are allocated with the node.

decisions.chosen: cid is the node id of the COMPARTMENT node (kind 1); atmosphere lives in a parallel comps table; EXTERIOR is node 0 with no comps row; M1 allocates COMPARTMENT nodes first so comp_base == node_base
decisions.reason: One id space so OPENING edges can name compartments as endpoints; keeps M1's {node_base, edge_base, comp_base} shape and Layout's graph_ref_base; layout_room_ref/node 0 constraints from the GDD.

decisions.chosen: int64 for conserved/extensive quantities and counters; int32 for ids, step stamps, bp, permille, W and short physical quantities; uint8 for enums and flags; range-check before any 32/8-bit store
decisions.reason: LS-1(a) and D.13 maxima; silent 32-bit truncation (ADR-0005 P9, P17; probe g).

decisions.chosen: Every persisted stamp is in Graph steps; step_no() = IntMath.floor_div(clock.tick(), GRAPH_STEP_TICKS); hdr.last_step_no persisted separately
decisions.reason: TR-itemdb-014 and FT-15 compare against step_no; kernel ticks never stored.

decisions.chosen: No file-level integer_division ignore; all division via IntMath; remedy for cost deferred to S1 and an ADR-0010 amendment
decisions.reason: ADR-0010 SIM-04/SIM-05 and PRJ-04 allow exactly one ignore in IntMath.trunc_div; contradicts GDD LS-1(d), recorded as gdd_sync; floor_div ~12x bare operator (ADR-0005 P14).

decisions.chosen: Typed builtins mini, maxi, clampi, absi, signi
decisions.reason: Probed 2026-10-29 to exist and return int; SIM-04 bans only the untyped names; foundation ask 2.

decisions.chosen: One String-keyed Dictionary with hdr plus a nested Dictionary per table mapping column name to a duplicate() of the packed column; schema fingerprint committed
decisions.reason: Sorted-key hash order applies per level; StringName keys are rejected by the ADR-0006 walk and round-trip as StringName (probe h); renames are a schema_version bump.

decisions.chosen: hdr is a Dictionary of eight named ints, not a packed array of slots
decisions.reason: Restore diffs name the key; eight values do not justify a slot-order document; ADR-0005 3.6 threshold concerns row arrays.

decisions.chosen: Overloaded payload columns (stock, req, req_max, aux_a, aux_b, tier, subtype) with a normative overlay and named accessors, instead of per-kind side tables
decisions.reason: Avoids five row-index maps and tables for a ~2.7 KB saving at ~105 nodes; side table named as a size lever only.

decisions.chosen: Flag bit 0 in the flags byte, distinct from state (SALVAGED is a live state); tombstoned rows keep id, kind, section_id and zero everything else; restore validates canonical zeros
decisions.reason: LS-10 distinguishes SALVAGED from discarded; canonical zeros give one encoding per state.

decisions.chosen: Four append-only counters, ascending-id dense rows, no compaction in MVP, persisted refs are ids with derived id-to-slot caches, ID_MAX 2^24, stale ids no-op
decisions.reason: LS-1(i), TR-lsg-027/028; no code may assume id equals slot so VS-A compaction changes allocator and cache only.

decisions.chosen: GraphIds code constants plus a committed assets/data/graph/ids.lock.json in the ADR-0007 ledger format, checked by LedgerCheck and the append-only CI gate
decisions.reason: ADR-0007 gives stability to ADR-0011 and no ledger; persisted enums reach saves; reuses existing machinery (foundation ask).

decisions.point: Hull stubs of a RAGGED cut
decisions.chosen: Appended HULL_SEGMENT node rows with a STUB flag, listed in the SeamRecord's stub_ids; can_detach must include CAPACITY
decisions.reason: Satisfies the GDD's 'no new persisted field' via existing columns; Layout GDD already lists CAPACITY in can_detach.

decisions.chosen: Four media (gas mGU, coolant mL, fuel mL, energy dJ) giving sixteen int64 section counters
decisions.reason: M16 is legal on a BATTERY in dJ and M6 discards battery stock; GDD sync asks the owner to confirm.

decisions.chosen: Closed S0-a for the data model: packed arrays alias by reference (ADR-0005 P7, probes c,d); next arrays live in GraphScratch and are swapped by reference; a snapshot is a duplicate(), never a local alias; ADR-0012 owns which columns and when
decisions.reason: Probed allocation-free swap; duplicate() is deferred copy-on-write (probe e).

decisions.point: Over-cap store on restore (TR-itemdb-033 vs LS-21)
decisions.chosen: Hard ceilings are GraphTuning physical maxima, not the catalog stock_cap; stock above a lowered live cap restores exactly and a stock reconcile at the head of every phase 0 clamps, credits disc_*, counts stock_clamped (not a saturation)
decisions.reason: Keeps snapshot(restore(x)) byte-identical and needs no REBASED cause; ADR-0016 may overrule (Open Question 2).

decisions.chosen: Twelve fixed steps, first failure wins, each mapped to one GRAPH_RESTORE_* reason; room-dependent checks (UNKNOWN_ROOM, n_max) in post_restore
decisions.reason: Deterministic reason per corrupt input for the 1,000-mutation fuzz; V comes from Layout, restored first.

decisions.chosen: Domain 3 local codes 1..24 (NOT_IN_SCOPE kept from ADR-0003, 13 RESTORE_*, 6 STRUCT_*, ID_SPACE_EXHAUSTED, DESC_STORE_OVERFLOW, STEP_RANGE, SATURATION); GRAPH_BOOT_* are domain-2 names; GraphFault.raise_in(scope, code, subject) statics
decisions.reason: ADR-0003 section 6 delegates the code list here; ADR-0007 section 2.3 puts boot errors in domain 2; GDD spelling lacked the scope argument.

decisions.chosen: Clamp + saturations[field] in release; GraphFaults.SATURATION under injected strict_numeric (tests, STRICT_DEBUG)
decisions.reason: LS-24 two tiers; build-mode equivalence holds on a clean stream.

decisions.chosen: Columnar store built in strictly ascending key order by construction, key = (subject_kind<<40)|(subject_id<<8)|mode, no sort
decisions.reason: ADR-0005 1.6 bans sort_custom; fixed visit order makes 'sorted' a property of construction; debug asserts ascent.

decisions.chosen: Caller-owned PackedInt32Array of store row indices plus count; FailureFilter with kind/mode/medium masks, section, compartment, min_sev, consequence_only, alarm_only, loaded_only
decisions.reason: A filtered result is non-contiguous so a slice cannot be a range; zero allocation per call (TR-lsg-019).

decisions.chosen: Kinds COMP 1..SECTION 9; L/ id = (loop<<24)|anchor; F/ keyed per subject as (subject_kind<<28)|id; N/ shared by NODE and EDGE kinds; quiet_writes_allowed true; buckets via floor_div, seeds in post_restore
decisions.reason: LS-20 delegated the packing here; 16-bit anchor would be exhausted by id churn; F per subject can only reduce key count.

decisions.chosen: Graph publishes true_value(LOAD_PM) with dead/idle/overload cases
decisions.reason: TR-instr-027 requires a Graph-published value; a second formula in Instruments would be a second source of truth (LS-19 changes).

decisions.chosen: Underscore-prefixed columns written only in graph_mutators/propagate/restore; caches only in graph_derived; enforced by a new config-driven OWN-01 plus an ARCH-06 exemption (foundation ask)
decisions.reason: No existing ADR-0010 rule expresses it and ARCH-06 forbids foreign ._member access.

decisions.chosen: Tunables via frozen GraphTuning lowercase accessors equal to registry LOCKED rows; six registry/kernel names forbidden as symbols in src/sim/graph and src/sim/suit via READ-03 token list
decisions.reason: Existing READ-03 mechanism suffices; one source of truth.

cross_adr_assumptions.assumption: Builds the descriptor store in phase 11 in the column layout and ascending-key order defined here; reads the last-emitted bucket seeds written in post_restore; includes the stock reconcile at the head of phase 0; owns can_join semantics and may only add output (res_*) fields to JoinPlan; owns which columns are double-buffered and when the swap happens using GraphScratch; owns topology refresh contents of GraphCaches.

Namespaces the keyed-RNG subject_id (thaw-burst) because node and edge ids overlap numerically (a node 5 and edge 5 would draw identically); also decides inlining of hot IntMath divisions after spike S1.

Layout allocates section_id and room_id (real section ids start at 1; 0 is the world EXTERIOR); M1 takes section_id as an argument and the Graph allocates node/edge/seam ids and returns {node_base, edge_base, comp_base}; Layout stores graph_ref_base as plain ids; templates list COMPARTMENT nodes first in room order; Layout's read view implements the RoomSource port and layout_room_ref is Layout's block-local room id.

graph.state restores after layout.state; post_restore runs after Layout's restore with cross-block reads allowed; a faulted post_restore (LOADING to FAULTED) never lets the restored world enter play; may relocate the stock reconcile to post_restore (then owing ADR-0006 a REBASED cause).

Calls weld_join/install_module/salvage_node/cut_detach inside Assembly's apply with pooled caller-owned JoinPlan/WeldResult/SalvageRecord objects; JoinPlan input fields are fixed by this ADR; can_detach includes CAPACITY because a RAGGED cut appends stub rows; orders the salvage/reinstall mutator calls per the section 5 column table.
Reads served_pm, run_pm and node state through the typed GraphView getters and failures(filter, out) at Graph ticks, with no subscription.
Perception Filter is the only non-diagnostic caller of true_value and wraps the published kinds P, P_O2, T, STOCK_PM, SUPPLY, DEMAND, LOAD_PM, HP.
Web Map calls M19 set_section_dormant and M1 inside its INIT scope; the dormant stamps (dormant_since, advanced step stamps) are the columns defined here.
Suit calls M15 draw_air and M16 withdraw_store through the declared Class B paths; the pending_draw queue and draw_grant table are the storage defined here.
The ambient mean uses served_pm(id) and nodes_in(cid, out) over Graph LOAD nodes only; self-powered fixtures are not Graph nodes.
